t_commit_evidence: Steps 39-42 all submit the identical str_replace command (same old_str with double-newline wrapper) that has already failed at steps 37 and 39; the agent shows no ability to break the loop, and the step budget runs out at step 42 with the parallel test script still unmodified.
t_surface_evidence: Step 20 output: 'ERROR: No replacement was performed, old_str ... did not appear verbatim in /app/stable_kmeans.py' — the first visible signal that the agent's str_replace usage is broken.
trigger_explanation: The agent's plan (optimize parameters, fix algorithm) was sound; its code generation of correct, complete old_str values for the str_replace tool consistently failed because it could not reproduce the exact whitespace/newline context around target snippets, despite reading the file contents immediately before each attempt.
forewarning_evidence: Step 20: first str_replace mismatch error. Steps 23, 26, 29, 32, 34, 35, 37, 39, 40, 41, 42 all show the same 'did not appear verbatim' error, with steps 34-35 and 39-42 being exact repeats of the same command.
